<milestone n="a. Mu tra" unit="section"/>   
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3811">mu tra</rs> yid kyi rnam shes rtog bcas kyi shes pa'i bzung bya yin zer ro || 
<milestone n=". 'Ban" unit="section"/> 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi bzung bya yin zer yang <rs type="work"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3748">dbus mtha</rs>'i ti ka</rs> rnam <choice><reg>shes</reg><orig>°es</orig></choice><note type="editorial">Reading uncertain</note> tshog <lb n="4b4"/> brgyad kyi rgyu'i cha la rgyu mtshan du bshad de ltar na kun gzhi sa bon gyi cha la rnam shes tshogs brgyad bskyed pa'i sa bon yod pas rgyu mtshan yin zer ¦ 
bsdu ba nas <expan>thams cad</expan> la rgyu mtshan gyi sgrar sbyar nas bshad de ming nyid shes pa'i bzung byar byung pa la ming rgyu mtshan ces dgongs pa'o || </seg></TEI>
